pages.title: Spirit Power
pages.text: Spirit power is your essential ability as a Saniwa to summon Touken Danshi.$(br)When your spirit power is insufficient, you will be unable to summon new blades.

pages.title: Spirit Power UI
pages.text: Your spirit power is displayed in the bottom-right corner of the screen. Please keep an eye on the remaining amount.

pages.title: Spirit Power Mechanic: Mass Anti-Invisibility for Sword Warriors
pages.text: When the player's Spirit Power exceeds 50, all summoned sword warriors will be granted the 'Sword Warrior: Anti-Invisibility' effect.$(br2)This effect, carried by the Spirit Power, allows sword warriors to detect invisible hostile mobs, giving them the ability to see through invisibility.$(br2)When Spirit Power is insufficient, this effect disappears until Spirit Power is restored.

pages.title: Spirit Power Mechanic: Hybrid Physical and Magic Damage
pages.text: When the player's Spirit Power exceeds 70, all summoned sword warriors will be granted the 'Sword Warrior: Hybrid Damage' effect.$(br2)This effect, carried by the Spirit Power, allows sword warriors to deal both physical and magic damage to monsters with different damage capabilities.$(br2)When Spirit Power is insufficient, this effect disappears until Spirit Power is restored.
